description: This file defines interfaces for an Application Gateway in a software project, including resolver, authenticator, responder, request handler, and telemetry interfaces, along with related data structures and constants.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::GatewayContext
classes.description: A struct holding context information for gateway requests, including request ID, connection ID, and application ID.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::IAppGatewayResolver
classes.description: Interface for resolving application gateway requests, allowing configuration of resolution paths and request resolution based on context and method.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::IAppGatewayAuthenticator
classes.description: Interface for authenticating sessions and checking permissions for applications.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::IAppGatewayResponder
classes.description: Interface for responding to, emitting notifications, and forwarding requests within the application gateway context.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::IAppGatewayResponder::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for connection status changes.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::IAppGatewayRequestHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling specific application gateway requests.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::IAppGatewayTelemetry
classes.description: Interface for recording telemetry events and metrics related to the gateway operation.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures resolution paths for the gateway.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a request based on the given context, origin, method, and parameters.

methods.name: Authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates an incoming session and returns the associated app ID.

methods.name: GetSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the session ID for an application.

methods.name: CheckPermissionGroup
methods.description: Checks if an application belongs to a specified permission group.

methods.name: Respond
methods.description: Provides a response to a specific gateway context.

methods.name: Emit
methods.description: Emits a notification to a specific gateway context.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Forwards a request to the client.

methods.name: GetGatewayConnectionContext
methods.description: Retrieves connection context parameters such as headers or URL parameters.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification interface for connection events.

methods.name: HandleAppGatewayRequest
methods.description: Handles an incoming application gateway request and provides an appropriate response.

methods.name: RecordTelemetryEvent
methods.description: Records a telemetry event associated with a specific gateway context.

methods.name: RecordTelemetryMetric
methods.description: Records a telemetry metric associated with a specific gateway context.

methods.name: void OnAppConnectionChanged(const string & appId,const uint32_t connectionId,const bool connected)
